telecom.info.title: COMMUNICATIONS AND ORBITS · NASA/JPL DATA
telecom.info.delay: Mars is between 55 and 400 million km from Earth. Radio waves travel at the speed of light and still take 3 to 22 minutes to arrive.
telecom.info.conjunction: Solar conjunction: every ≈26 months the Sun sits exactly between Mars and Earth, blocking all radio contact for about two weeks.
telecom.info.orbits: Computed in real time from Standish's orbital elements (NASA/JPL).
telecom.info.antenna: Dish antenna: it focuses the signal towards the relay satellite. If the azimuth (turn angle) drifts, the data rate and coverage drop.
